$comment: Scout configuration. Edit freely: 'ashby' entries are jobs.ashbyhq.com board slugs, 'greenhouse' entries are boards-api.greenhouse.io board tokens (slug -> display name). Filters are case-insensitive regex strings applied to role titles; a title must match 'relevant' and not match 'disqualify'. Set usOnly=false to keep non-US roles. Tuned for internships/entry-level in data science, CS, biotech, bioinformatics, healthtech, and analytics (unlike a senior-SWE-only config, 'intern'/'new grad'/'analyst' are NOT disqualified here).
